_help: Edit this file by hand (you can do it on your phone in the GitHub app or github.com). Everything here shows on the page. Live TikTok numbers live in stats.json and update themselves every day, so don't edit that one.
name: Hafizur
intro: Hey! I’m Hafizur, a London-based content creator with a background in pharmacy and a passion for travel, lifestyle and visual storytelling.

I love creating videos around the things I’m genuinely passionate about, whether that’s exploring new destinations, discovering unique experiences or capturing everyday moments. I aim to make my content relatable, entertaining and engaging, connecting with audiences through authentic storytelling.

From cinematic, visually captivating videos to fun, relatable content, I enjoy experimenting with different styles and bringing fresh, creative ideas to life. I’m always thinking of new and unique ways to capture experiences and showcase brands.

I’ve grown my platform organically through authentic content that resonates with audiences. My focus is on creating shareable videos that reach beyond my existing audience, generating hundreds of thousands of views and, at times, millions.
I’m always looking to collaborate with brands, hotels and businesses to create original content that showcases their offerings, captures attention and leaves a lasting impression.
_style_videos_help: Media kit 'Video styles' section (above Top videos). One entry per style: paste the TikTok link as url and a short style name as label. Leave the list empty [] to hide the section.
_bio_links_help: The buttons on your link-in-bio page, top to bottom. Add, remove or reorder freely. icon can be: kit, tiktok, instagram, mail, link, play, star, plane. Add "bottom": true to put a button below the videos.
_featured_help: Video tiles on your home page, in this order. Paste TikTok video links (or just the long number). The tiles' pictures and view counts fill in a couple of minutes after you save. Leave the list empty [] to hide the section.

audience._note: Copy these from TikTok Studio > Analytics > Viewers (or Beacons) once a month.

_brands_help: Brands I've worked with, shown as tiles. name is required. logo: image in assets/brands/. bg: tile colour behind the logo. caption: small text under the logo.

services.title: Dedicated TikTok
services.text: A full video built around your hotel, attraction or product, filmed on location.

services.title: Hosted stay or visit

services.title: UGC for your channels

stats_settings._note: How the averages are worked out: videos posted in the last window_days days (at least min_videos videos), leaving out ones newer than skip_newer_than_days because they are still gaining views.
